text: Self-service analytics means lots of people building lots of content — and gates alone can't keep that organized. Endorsement is Fabric's other lever: not a gate, a signal.

Every Fabric item carries this same pane: None, Promoted, Certified, Master Data. Promoted is low-bar by design — any owner can flag their own item as worth using. Certified and Master Data are a different story entirely.
Because Certified means something, not everyone can grant it. An admin enables certification tenant-wide and decides exactly who's authorized to apply it — off by default, on purpose.
Scaled up across a real catalog, that badge is the scanning advantage — Master data or Certified tells a report author which copy to build on, without asking around.
Signals that travel with the item, visible the moment someone's scanning the catalog. Next lesson: Purview integration — what happens when that catalog needs to span more than just Fabric.
